content.short: StonkBrokers is a 4,444-piece NFT collection on Robinhood Chain with ERC-6551 token-bound wallets.
content.description: StonkBrokers is a collection of 4,444 pixel stock brokers on Robinhood Chain, each holding an ERC-6551 token-bound wallet so the NFT itself can own assets. Brokers trade on the project's Anvil AMM, a ve(3,3) DEX where users swap, provide liquidity and stake for UP emissions. Holders collect stock token distributions, and the STONKBROKER token trades against USDG on the project's own exchange. The team has launched further tokens from the same system, including YARD, WALL, MANCER and the STRIKE vault token.
